raw_text: Pakistan Air Force has inducted the first JF-17 Thunder Block 3 fighter aircraft at a ceremony held at PAC Kamra on Thursday. Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Babar presided over the event and described the aircraft as a game-changer for PAF's operational readiness. The Block 3 features advanced avionics, AESA radar, and enhanced weapons capability. Pakistan plans to produce 50 Block 3 aircraft domestically under license from China.
